title: What wedding calls for all this?
literal_meaning: For what wedding is there alta on both feet?
meaning_odia: ଅତି ସାମାନ୍ୟ କାମ ବା ଅବସର ପାଇଁ ବହୁତ ବଡ଼ ଆୟୋଜନ କରିବାକୁ ଏହି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଥଟ୍ଟା କରେ। ଦୁଇ ଗୋଡ଼ରେ ଅଳତା ଲଗାଇ ଏତେ ସଜ ହେବାକୁ କେଉଁ ବାହାଘର ଅଛି ବୋଲି ପଚାରି ଅବସର ଓ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତିର ଅମେଳ ଦେଖାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The question mocks preparations that seem too elaborate for the occasion. The inspected gloss explicitly applies it to making a large arrangement for a minor event. The wedding adornment supplies the image of a level of preparation that the actual occasion scarcely calls for.
usage_example: A brief informal visit is being planned like a grand reception. Someone uses the saying to question the scale of the arrangements. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: Alta is a red cosmetic dye used to colour the feet. The saying itself pairs this adornment with a wedding, then questions whether there is an occasion substantial enough to warrant it.

witnesses.note: Display follows this complete readable wording; source gloss identifies elaborate arrangements for a minor occasion.
